$schema_comment: Harness hooks and permissions. Claude Code runs the hooks, not the agent. For a hook to BLOCK it has to exit with 2 and write the reason to stderr: with exit 1 the output is shown and the session carries on. scripts/harness_hook.py takes care of that, and it works on both Windows and POSIX. PreToolUse is the only one that arrives BEFORE the write; the other two arrive once it already happened. In permissions, deny always beats allow. See docs/scripts.md.

hooks.description: Stops writes to the layer that verifies the work, unless maintenance is declared.
After editing or writing files, runs the tests and blocks if they are broken.
Before closing the session, runs the verifier and blocks the close if it is red.
